zh.title: 印度國防部啟動105億美元中型運輸機招標案
zh.summary: 印度國防部正式發出中型運輸機招標書，預計耗資百億美元採購六十架飛機。
body: 印度國防部於2026年8月12日正式發出招標書（RFP），採購60架中型運輸機（MTA），正式開啟這項估計價值約1兆盧比（約合105億美元）的採購競爭。此招標案旨在為印度空軍引進新一代中型運輸機，以汰換現有的An-32及Il-76運輸機機隊。

本次招標邀請已發送至五家印度本土企業，分別為塔塔先進系統（Tata Advanced Systems）、馬辛德拉（Mahindra）、阿達尼國防與航太（Adani Defence and Aerospace）、印度航太工業（Hindustan Aeronautics Limited）以及信實國防（Reliance Defence）。預計每家參標的印度本土企業都將與一家外國飛機製造商合作提出競標方案。

此次採購案的技術規格要求飛機的有效載荷需介於18至30噸之間。這項標準使洛克希德·馬丁（Lockheed Martin）的C-130J以及巴西航空工業（Embraer）的C-390 Millennium（千禧年）成為主要的競爭對手。空中巴士（Airbus）先前曾提議提供A400M運輸機，但該機型載重量約為37噸，超出了規定的上限。C-130J-30超級海格力斯（Super Hercules）的載重量約為19噸，接近該標準的下限；而C-390的載重量則約為26噸，接近該範圍的上限。
在已公開的合作夥伴中，塔塔先進系統與洛克希德·馬丁於2024年9月10日簽署了合作協議，共同推廣C-130J-30運輸機。與此同時，馬辛德拉自2024年2月9日在新德里簽署備忘錄以來，便一直與巴西航空工業合作開發C-390項目。其餘三家獲得招標邀請的印度企業目前則尚未公開其外國合作夥伴。
根據招標要求，首批飛機將以整機進口（flyaway）方式交付，而其餘飛機則必須在印度境內製造。中選的合作團隊將被要求在印度國內建立總裝線（FAL）以及維修保養能力。競標方案在通過技術評估後，將進行實地測試，包括在拉達克（Ladakh）及東北部地區的高海拔和簡易跑道（Advanced Landing Grounds）上進行起降測試。

en.title: India Opens $10.5 Billion Tender to Procure 60 Medium Transport Aircraft
en.summary: The Indian Defence Ministry issued a tender on August 12 to procure 60 medium transport aircraft.
body: The Indian Ministry of Defence issued a request for proposals on August 12, 2026, for 60 medium transport aircraft, formally opening a procurement competition estimated at approximately 1 trillion rupees ($10.5 billion). The program aims to secure a new generation of transport aircraft for the Indian Air Force to replace its ageing An-32 and Il-76 fleets.

The tender was issued to five Indian companies: Tata Advanced Systems, Mahindra, Adani Defence and Aerospace, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, and Reliance Defence. Each of these domestic entities is expected to form a partnership with a foreign aircraft manufacturer to submit their respective bids.

The technical requirements for the procurement program specify an aircraft payload capacity in the 18 to 30-ton class. This range positions Lockheed Martin's C-130J and Embraer's C-390 Millennium as the primary contenders. Airbus had previously proposed the A400M, though at approximately 37 tons, the aircraft exceeds the stated payload ceiling. The C-130J-30 Super Hercules offers a payload capacity of approximately 19 tons, near the lower limit of the requirement, while the C-390 offers about 26 tons, placing it near the top of the specified range.

Two bid pairings have already been made public. Tata Advanced Systems signed a teaming agreement with Lockheed Martin on September 10, 2024, to offer the C-130J-30 Super Hercules. Meanwhile, Mahindra has been collaborating with Embraer on the C-390 since signing a memorandum of understanding in New Delhi on February 9, 2024. The other three Indian tender recipients have not yet publicly identified their foreign aerospace partners.

Under the terms of the tender, an initial tranche of aircraft will be delivered in flyaway condition, while the remaining units must be built within India. The winning partnership will be required to establish a final assembly line and maintenance, repair, and overhaul capabilities inside the country. Following a technical evaluation, the bids will undergo field trials, which will include testing at high-altitude and semi-prepared airstrips, such as the Advanced Landing Grounds in Ladakh and the northeastern regions.

zh.title: 俄羅斯開始交付國產化替代型Il-114-300渦槳支線機
zh.summary: 俄羅斯宣布開始交付首批國產化Il-114-300；2026至2027年交付量有限且設嚴格操作限制
body: 俄羅斯第一副總理Denis Manturov宣布，首批國產化替代型Ilyushin Il-114-300渦槳支線機已開始交付。俄羅斯官方媒體Obyasnyaem RF引述Manturov表示：「我們正開始首批Il-114-300飛機的交付。」
Manturov另指出，更新版Tu-214的量產正在提升，MC-21與Superjet則處於測試與認證的最後階段。他稱現代民用航空機隊的建立具有關鍵重要性，該計畫正進入實際執行階段。
2026年6月，俄羅斯《Kommersant》報導，運輸部長Andrei Nikitin宣布2026年預計交付3架Il-114-300，2027年約交付相同數量，之後產能將逐步提升。實際交付數量未正式公布，但外界認為相當有限。
Il-114-300配備俄製Klimov TV7-117ST-01渦槳發動機與國產航電系統，而舊款Il-114-100則採用加拿大普惠發動機與外製航電。該機型為66座基準容量的支線渦槳機，設計用途為取代老舊的Antonov An-24與An-26。
俄羅斯聯邦航空運輸局（Rosaviatsiya）於2026年6月重新核發Il-114型號合格證。合格證資料顯示，Il-114-300僅獲准在攝氏零下9度至正25度的狹窄氣溫範圍內運作，禁止在結冰與雷暴條件下飛行，且僅限人工鋪面跑道起降。機場海拔限制為負300公尺至正1000公尺，緯度限制為正負70度。
俄羅斯遠東地區航空公司Aurora預計為Il-114-300的主要客戶之一，訂購20架，但據《Kommersant》報導，Aurora預計要到2028年才會接收首架飛機。

en.title: Russia begins deliveries of import-substituted Ilyushin Il-114-300 turboprops
en.summary: Russia announces first import-substituted Il-114-300 deliveries; 2026–2027 volumes minimal with strict operating limits
body: Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov has announced that the first import-substituted Ilyushin Il-114-300 regional turboprops have begun delivery. The official Russian news outlet Obyasnyaem RF quoted Manturov as stating, "We are beginning the first deliveries of the Il-114-300 aircraft."

Manturov added that serial production of the updated Tu-214 is ramping up, while the MC-21 and Superjet are in the final stages of testing and certification. He described the creation of a modern civil aviation fleet as being of key importance, saying the program is moving into practical implementation.

In June 2026, Russia's Kommersant reported that Transport Minister Andrei Nikitin announced delivery of three Il-114-300s is expected in 2026 and approximately the same number in 2027, with production capacity to increase thereafter. The delivery numbers were not officially announced and appear to be very modest.

The Il-114-300 is produced with Russian Klimov TV7-117ST-01 turboprop engines and domestic avionics, while the older Il-114-100 was produced with Canadian Pratt & Whitney engines and foreign-made avionics. The regional turboprop has a 66-seat baseline capacity and is intended to replace ageing Antonov An-24 and An-26 aircraft.

Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency (Rosaviatsiya) reissued the type certificate for the Il-114 in June 2026. According to the type certificate data sheet, the Il-114-300 is only certified for operation in a temperature range of -9 to +25 degrees Celsius, is prohibited from operating in icy conditions and thunderstorms, and is permitted to take off and land only from runways with artificial surfaces. Airport elevations are limited to -300 meters to +1,000 meters, with latitude set to plus or minus 70 degrees.

Russian Far East airline Aurora is expected to be one of the biggest customers for the aircraft with an order for 20 examples, but Kommersant reported that Aurora is not expected to receive its first aircraft until 2028.
